title: Handoff
description: State snapshot of a conversation: where things stand, what is ruled out, what is next. Write facts, not a story. A section with nothing in it is written as an empty list, never left out.

_meta.notes: Read by people and models; handoff.py validates with its own code (no third-party validator). Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.

date.description: Date of the handoff, YYYY-MM-DD. Never 'today'.

recipient.description: ai = new chat session, human = colleague, self = future you.

kind.description: Kind of work; see profiles.json for the extra fields each kind needs.

objective.description: The goal in 1-2 sentences, with success criteria if any were set.

current_state.description: Where things stand right now: the 'you are here' marker. Facts, not the order things happened.

decisions.description: Settled choices. Only what the user decided or accepted; a suggestion nobody accepted is not a decision.

why.description: The reason, so the next session does not reopen it.

dead_ends.description: Approaches tried or rejected. The most valuable and most omitted section.

why.description: Why it failed or was rejected; say if the reason is fixable.

artifacts.description: Every file, draft or deliverable. Only the current version, plus what it superseded.

location.description: Path or URL exactly as it exists.

status.description: final, draft, or superseded by X.

verbatim.description: Values that must survive character for character. Each value must occur literally in the thread; check proves it.

preferences.description: User corrections and style rules learned in the thread, each one a preference already paid for.

next.description: ONE concrete step, starting with a verb.

unblocks.description: What has to happen before it can move.

unresolved.description: Questions or contradictions the thread never settled. Do not pick a winner.

uncertain.description: Things implied but never confirmed; the reader must not rely on them.
